adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, which explicitly mutates parsed data when `refresh_token` is missing: `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:21). In `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is merged into the stored credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` and then persisted to Prisma. If the refresh response lacks `refresh_token` (which is allowed when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` causes the minimum schema to be used), this merge will overwrite the real stored refresh token with the literal string "refresh_token", breaking subsequent normal refreshes. The finding is directly grounded in the shown code paths.
